residuals.family: a spelling assembled at run time (an array join, a non-constant template, a value from settings or the environment) is no text and no cooked constant; this census's own needles are of this form
an encoded spelling (base64, percent-encoding, an HTML entity) and every archive or media payload are not decoded; the roster's vendored excerpts are base64

a homoglyph or combining-mark spelling (a Cyrillic letter for a Latin one, an Arabic-Indic digit for the major's ASCII one) is not folded to Latin or ASCII; the major's own digits are ASCII after NFKC (wb-1du7)
an HTML tag splitting the spelling is read as raw text, never rendered; emphasis, code and strike marks are separators
a line break ends every reading, so a spelling broken across two lines reads nothing
GraphPolicyCLI envelope and registry ids (graphpolicy.rpc, cli, journal, limits, error, project and the rest of the producer's schema-ids registry) are outside R1's identity pair and read nothing
a GraphPolicyCLI namespace without a major names no schema id and reads nothing

a suffix set off by whitespace, or led by a mark outside the separators and the plus sign in any script (#, @, a bracket, U+2010 HYPHEN), a separator run that no letter, mark or digit follows (a sentence stop, U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW), and a separator-led word that opens another GP namespace (a following id) each end the reading, so the id before it reads exact; a pre-release written after a space reads as prose; a letter, mark or digit of any script continues the major (wb-1du7 F1)

a bound case is found in its test source, never in vitest's report, so a registered case that asserts nothing, or one that never runs (skip in its options object or its suite's, a skip called on its test context in its body, an empty it.each or describe.each table, a dead or conditional registration, a proof file the default tier never runs: a non-test path or an excluded live-tier file), still binds here; the binding's census-tier judge leg is where the shared helper reads it: judge() counts a pin only when it is collected exactly once and passed under its tier (the wb-u62 helper's stated contract, not re-measured here)

the judge leg is located by its import of judge and by the case's file and title as string tokens, never by reading its judge call (the pins it passes and their tier), the case that holds it or the verdicts that call returns, so a leg that never calls judge, judges another tier, ignores its verdicts or registers its own case skipped still judges the binding here
